title: Annoying ads on premium, no Support
body: I have purchased the premium for the Growth bundle, but Done app still shows annoying ads asking to purchase Premium EVERY TIME you use the app. I have tried everything - restoring purchase many many times, reinstalling the app (and losing data), restarting the phone, etc. Support is not responsive and my messages were ignored, so had to ask Apple for refund.
author: Adomas L.

title: Why I love it?
body:
I found the Done app first a few months back. Only now I’ve discovered the app bundle - Last, Tally, Grateful, Do (there’s Moody also, did not use it yet) - I really enjoy them! 
It’s because of the simplicity and base functions - it makes the apps really flexible.
I use some for good, other ones for bad habits, Do app - for setting 3 main goals for the day, grateful - for motivation. 
The only thing Do (bundle) app lacks: checkbox. To let my imagination run - I imagine an app with toggle switches (like on Marshall speakers), with 3 satisfying switches when you’ve done something - check out Simone Giertz board.
